div.head: II Cn 51.1
div.ab: Ne byð na gelic, þæt man wið swustor gehæme ⁊ hit wære feorr sibb.
Ne bið na gelic, þæt man swustor gehame ⁊ hit wære feor sib.
Non est equale, si quis cum sorore sua concumbat et fuerit de longe pertinens.
Ne byð na gelic þæt man wið swustor gehæme ⁊ þes þe hit bið feor sibbe.
Ne byð na gelic, þæt man wið swustor gehæme and hit wære feorr sibb.
Es ist nicht gleichgiltig, ob jemand der Schwester beiwohne, oder es eine entfernt Verwandte wäre.
It is not the same whether one lies with a sister or whether it were a distant relative.
The cases are not alike if incest is committed with a sister or with a distant relation.
It is by no means on a level whether a man has intercourse with his sister, or with a distant relation.
Fornication with one’s sister shall not be considered comparable to fornication with a distant relation.
div.note: G places 51.1 before 52.1, one line too low.
